name: Kasamandl
beschreibung: Gasthof Kasamandl welcomes guests to the community of Kirchbichl in the Kufstein district. This traditional family-managed inn is characterized by authentic Tyrolean hospitality and charming dining parlors. Leisure and business travelers appreciate the comfortable, well-kept rooms furnished with classic alpine wood accents. The restaurant serves comforting home-style Tyrolean fare alongside seasonal dishes made from local farm produce. Located conveniently in the Inn Valley, it provides an ideal base for exploring Kufstein Fortress, the local swimming lake, and the hiking and ski slopes of the Hohe Salve region.
kurzbeschreibung: Traditional inn in Kirchbichl in the lower Inn Valley offering hearty Tyrolean cuisine and a cozy parlor.
